summary: Plan v5 (faithful tree-recursive Hilbert bridge). This dispatch continued Phase 8 sub-step 8.2 (Phase 8.1 landed by the previous dispatch). Landed, across nine commits, a substantial reusable propositional-combinator toolkit over Derivable CS5ModalAxiom (imp_trans/and/andE1/andE2/orI1/orI2/mp/of_derivable/self/trans_under, curry/uncurry, box_mono/imp_congr_right), bigAndL/factsAt infrastructure (bigAndL_mem/mono/cons, factsAt_cons_ne/self), the ancestor-wrap bridge (nikTrFuel_of_derivable/nikTr_of_sigAt_imp/nikTrFuel_mono), and sigAt-core infrastructure (sigAt_imp_of_factsAt_imp, sigAtFuel_congr_above_rank, sigAt_cons_self_imp) -- culminating in 8 of the 10 in-scope Phase-8.2 constructor cases landed as standalone core lemmas (sigAt_assumption/_andI/_andE1/_andE2/_orI1/_orI2/_impE/_impI), each sorry-free, axiom-clean, and scoped-build green, committed individually. Before attempting the remaining two cross-label cases (efq, orE -- report 04's hardest cases), a design-level analysis (not a machine-checked Lean attempt) found that the 'core' sigAt-only motive used for the 8 landed cases cannot close efq/orE: a bare sigAt-x fact carries no route to an unrelated label y, whereas the full nikTr ancestor-wrap threads in off-spine sibling subtrees via IsDerivationForest's single-rooted-tree guarantee. Closing efq/orE needs nik_adequacy's motive restated at the full nikTr level plus an explicit lowest-common-ancestor bridging argument -- substantial, not yet attempted. This is a documented scope/design finding, NOT a blocker: no sorry, no axiom, no vacuous placeholder; Phase 8.2 stays [IN PROGRESS], not [BLOCKED].
decisions_made: Factored nik_adequacy's proof through a standalone 'core' fact (Derivable((sigAt G Γ hfin x).imp A)) plus a generic one-time ancestor-wrap (nikTr_of_sigAt_imp), rather than working with the full nikTr-wrapped statement at every case -- valid and load-bearing for the 8 propositional/impI cases, but discovered (by analysis, at this dispatch's tail end) to be insufficient for efq/orE, which need the full nikTr-level motive plus a lowest-common-ancestor bridge.

PD.1's bot_backward/bot_iff_edge/bot_iff_TClosure (flagged in the plan as reusable for efq) are semantic (CKForces) facts for the superseded direct-motive route, not syntactic Derivable/sigAt facts -- NOT reusable for this Hilbert-bridge route. New syntactic infrastructure will be needed for efq/orE instead.

Landed nikTrFuel_mono (wrap preserves entailment, not just closed derivability) and cs5_deriv_box_mono/cs5_deriv_imp_congr_right as the first reusable pieces a nikTr-level motive redesign would need, even though the redesign itself was not attempted this dispatch.
